description: A normal fish with no special effects.
An effect that make the fish shiny, and appreciates the value of the fish.
An effect that burns the fish, potentially poisonous.
A fish that has radiation, extremely toxic (DO NOT CONSUME).
Scales shift through a dazzling array of rainbow colors. Mesmerizing to look at.
A fish that has been dead for a few months and now is in the process of decomposing. It emits a foul odor and is covered in slime.
